issues.summary: Float-model closures were admitted for certification without 64-bit intermediate evidence.
issues.reproduction: cargo test --offline --locked -p uorust --lib certify::tests::float_model_closures_are_refused_before_export_ue_20 -- --exact; before guard direct/transitive/integer were admitted; after guard only integer is admitted.
acceptance_criteria: Direct and transitive Prelude float closures omitted from production request.
Refusal recorded by root kappa with unbounded-float-model cause.
Batch requests cannot re-admit refused roots.
Unrelated integer roots remain eligible.
Qualified and unqualified aliases and non-float-named Prelude aliases cannot hide a reachable float helper; unused definitions and bit identity do not trigger refusal.

issues.function: Prelude::floatMul, floatDiv, floatFma, floatSqrt, floatSumCore, floatPow2
issues.summary: Mathematical Nat intermediates exceed the checked u64 production representation.
acceptance_criteria: Provide source-owned bounded multi-limb or bounded alternative arithmetic for all reachable intermediates.
Prove/check target preservation and resource bounds; a u128 substitution alone is insufficient.
Preserve subnormals, signed zeros, NaN policy and rounding requirements.

issues.function: Production export of actual IEEE float root closures
issues.summary: Full IEEE root export and compiled execution have not been established.
issues.reproduction: The production probe exports only Nat multiplication; do not interpret it as a full floatMul export.
acceptance_criteria: Export and replay actual floatMul/Div/Fma/Sqrt closures under the selected exact SDK.
Compile emitted source to native and Wasm; execute boundary and randomized vectors.
Record exact root, input domain, output/exception semantics and all toolchain hashes.
Compare ordered operations to an independent IEEE oracle, including cancellation and extreme exponents.

issues.summary: Oversized significand products produce explicit checked Overflow, not silent wrong results in tested compiled artifacts.
issues.reproduction: bash scripts/probe-numeric-export.sh within the selected pinned SDK; package fixture in UORust repair commit.
acceptance_criteria: Generated primitive bundle verifies.
Native and import-free Wasm return overflow for 2^52*2^52 and (2^53-1)^2.
Zero, u64::MAX*1 and binary32 significand controls succeed.
issues.scope: Exact inner multiplication primitive only; full IEEE export not tested.
